description: This file implements the USB Bluetooth class for Zephyr OS, including USB descriptors, endpoint configurations, thread routines for HCI data transmission, and USB event handling for Bluetooth over USB.

methods.name: hci_tx_thread
methods.description: Thread function for transmitting HCI data over USB, handling suspend/resume states and dispatching data to appropriate USB endpoints.

methods.name: hci_rx_thread
methods.description: Thread function for receiving HCI data from USB and passing it to the Bluetooth driver.

methods.name: hci_pkt_get_len
methods.description: Calculates the total length of an HCI packet based on its header.

methods.name: acl_read_cb
methods.description: Callback for reading ACL data from USB endpoint, assembling packets, and queuing them for transmission.

methods.name: bluetooth_status_cb
methods.description: Handles USB connection status events, manages configuration state, and starts/stops data transfers accordingly.

methods.name: vs_read_usb_transport_mode
methods.description: Handles vendor-specific command to read supported USB transport modes.

methods.name: vs_set_usb_transport_mode
methods.description: Handles vendor-specific command to set the USB transport mode.

methods.name: bluetooth_class_handler
methods.description: Handles class-specific USB requests for Bluetooth.

methods.name: bluetooth_interface_config
methods.description: Configures the Bluetooth USB interface with the interface number.

methods.name: bluetooth_init
methods.description: Initializes the Bluetooth USB class, sets up raw HCI channel, and creates communication threads.
